name: budget-variance
workflow: month end budget vs actuals variance threshold flags
description: Month-end budget vs actuals: total the GL actuals by cost center and account, compare with budget, flag lines over the percent and absolute thresholds plus any unbudgeted spend, write commentary and draft an email to the FP&A lead.

threshold_pct.description: flag when |variance| >= this percent of budget

steps.intent: Check the budget and GL actuals for {period} exist and have the expected columns
Total actuals by cost center and account, compare with budget and flag lines over {threshold_pct}% and {threshold_abs}
Write variance commentary for {period} listing every flagged line
steps.instructions: Read output/variance_summary_{period}.json and output/variance_flags_{period}.csv; write output/variance_note_{period}.md with the flagged count, totals and one line per flagged line, largest first.

script.code:
import csv, json, os
period = PARAMS['period']
s = json.load(open(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f'variance_summary_{period}.json')))
with open(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f'variance_flags_{period}.csv'), newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    flags = list(csv.DictReader(f))
lines = [f'# Budget vs actuals, {period}', '',
         f"{s['flagged']} of {s['lines']} cost-center lines are flagged (threshold {s['threshold_pct']:g}% and {s['threshold_abs']:,.0f}).",
         f"Budget {s['total_budget']:,.2f}; actual {s['total_actual']:,.2f}; variance {s['total_variance']:,.2f}.", '']
for r in sorted(flags, key=lambda r: -abs(float(r['variance']))):
    pct = f" ({r['variance_pct']}%)" if r['variance_pct'] else ''
    lines.append(f"- {r['cost_center']} / {r['account']}: {r['flag']}, variance {float(r['variance']):,.2f}{pct}")
lines += ['', f'Details: variance_{period}.csv']
open(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f'variance_note_{period}.md'), 'w', encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(lines))
print('\n'.join(lines))

steps.intent: Draft an email to {recipient} with the variance commentary and flagged lines attached

input.subject: Budget vs actuals {period}: flagged variances
input.body:
Hi,

The budget vs actuals review for {period} is ready. The commentary is in variance_note_{period}.md and the flagged lines are attached.

This draft was prepared by the analyst agent and checked before sending.
input.name: variance-email-{period}
